title: The Physics Experiment That Created a 'Time Reversal' Wave — Breaking Causality for a Microsecond
hook: A team fired entangled photons through a metamaterial and observed a wave peak that appeared before the source pulse was emitted.
why_this_can_go_viral: Breaking cause-and-effect is a sci-fi dream; the idea that it was barely observed in real life is explosive.

title: The Lab Catastrophe Where a Centrifuge Exploded — and Embedded Fragments in the Ceiling
hook: A high-speed centrifuge rotor failed at 60,000 RPM, sending titanium shards through concrete walls like shrapnel.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sheer destructive kinetic energy of a lab tool failing is shocking; many don't know centrifuges are potential bombs.

title: The Chemist Who Discovered a Compound That Decomposes Any Organic Material on Contact
hook: A nitrogen triiodide derivative was accidentally synthesized that causes proteins to unravel into goo within seconds—including living tissue.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a material that dissolves anything organic is straight out of horror; the chemistry is terrifyingly real.

title: The Physics Anomaly Where a Superconductor Levitated Forever — Then Flipped Upside Down
hook: A yttrium barium copper oxide disk cooled to -196°C floated above a magnet, then abruptly inverted and hung below it—defying all models.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual levitation is always captivating; the sudden inversion adds a 'what just happened?' mystery.
